description:
**《Dreifaches Konzert》——与古老维也纳乐派的对话** 传统不是终点，而是一种挑战。 在《Dreifaches Konzert》中，我尝试以自己的方式重新诠释古老的维也纳乐派。这并不是为了复刻过去，而是希望以它为基础，去质疑、探索，并发展属于我自己的音乐语言。 对我而言，伟大的古典作曲传统既是一种严谨的训练，也是一种持续的挑战。它要求作曲者理解音乐的结构，掌握张力的塑造，并拥有超越既有形式的勇气。 这部作品是一次持续进行的对话——传统与想象之间，过去的严谨与当下的创作自由之间。 古典大师为我奠定基础。而在这片基础之上，我选择建造什么，则是我自己的责任。 **这不是为了回到过去，而是为了探索：过去的音乐传统，今天依然能够开启怎样的可能。** 《Dreifaches Konzert》作品预告。 ____________________________________ **Dreifaches Konzert — A Dialogue with the Old Viennese School** Tradition is not a destination. It is a challenge. With *Dreifaches Konzert*, I explore my own interpretation of the Old Viennese School — not as an attempt to recreate the past, but as a foundation from which to question, discover, and develop my own musical language. For me, the great tradition of classical composition is both a discipline and a provocation. It demands an understanding of structure, an awareness of musical tension, and the courage to go beyond what is already known. This piece is part of an ongoing dialogue between heritage and imagination, between the discipline of the past and the creative freedom of the present. The old masters provide the foundation. What I build upon it is my own responsibility. **This is not about returning to the past. It is about discovering what the past can still make possible.** A preview of *Dreifaches Konzert*.

Tradition is not a destination. It is a challenge.
With *Dreifaches Konzert*, I explore my own interpretation of the Old Viennese School — not as an attempt to recreate the past, but as a foundation from which to question, discover, and develop my own musical language.
For me, the great tradition of classical composition is both a discipline and a provocation. It demands an understanding of structure, an awareness of musical tension, and the courage to go beyond what is already known.
This piece is part of an ongoing dialogue between heritage and imagination, between the discipline of the past and the creative freedom of the present.
The old masters provide the foundation. What I build upon it is my own responsibility.
